title: Curvature Recycling Douglas-Rachford Splitting: Transported Quasi-Newton Models for Expensive Smooth Proximal Subproblems
summary: We consider \[ \min_x f(x)+g(x), \] where $f$ is smooth but its value and gradient are expensive, while $g$ is nonsmooth and has a cheap proximal map. Douglas--Rachford splitting (DRS) then requires a sequence of smooth proximal solves. These solves have different centers but share the same nonlinear curvature. We introduce curvature-recycling DRS (CR-DRS). The method transports an old exact residual to the new proximal center, reuses a quasi-Newton model, and moves the old proximal state before the first new gradient is evaluated.
